# DEVVIBES

> A senior engineering studio in Yerevan, Armenia, designing and shipping AI,
> web, and mobile platforms — from first architecture through to the system
> running in production.

Site: https://devvibes.dev/            (English)
     https://devvibes.dev/hy/         (Armenian)
Contact: hello@devvibes.dev · +374 95 073 707 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/37495073707
Languages: English, Armenian — separate URLs, not a client-side toggle

## What the studio does

- AI solutions — production-grade agents, retrieval pipelines, inference platforms
- SaaS platforms — multi-tenant, auth, billing, role-based access
- Mobile apps — native iOS and Android, plus React Native
- Cloud architecture — AWS and GCP foundations
- Enterprise systems — internal platforms, ERPs, integrations
- UI / UX design — design systems, motion, product UX
- DevOps and infrastructure — CI/CD, observability, security baselines
- Web applications

## How the studio works

Four steps: Discover (workshops, technical audit, product strategy), Design
(design systems, prototypes, accessibility), Develop (two-week increments,
CI/CD, test automation), Scale (observability, performance, cost).

## Work

- Toghramajyan Clinic — https://toghramajyanclinic.am/preview
  Healthcare, Yerevan. Client engagement, pre-launch preview. Trilingual
  (Armenian, Russian, English) clinic platform covering eight specialties, plus
  an automated appointment-intake layer.

- Hospity — https://hospity.devvibes.dev
  Hospitality. DEVVIBES' own product, in private beta. Turns a hotel check-in QR
  into guest self-service for room service, spa, activities and housekeeping,
  with requests routed to staff in real time and a dashboard for owners.

## Notes for indexers

- Each locale is a single page; sections are in-page anchors (#work, #services,
  #process, #stack, #contact). / and /hy/ are the same content in two
  languages and declare each other via hreflang.
- Figures shown are scope facts verifiable on the linked sites, not performance
  claims. The studio publishes no invented metrics or client testimonials.
- No pricing is published. Enquire by email.
